title: Landlocked Countries
intro: Countries with no sea coast. Every answer shows its source.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has no sea coast?
questions.explain: The UN list of landlocked developing countries includes Mongolia; Vietnam, Peru and Kenya all have an ocean coastline.

questions.prompt: Which of these Horn of Africa countries is landlocked?
questions.explain: The UN list of landlocked developing countries includes Ethiopia; Eritrea, Somalia and Djibouti all border the sea.

questions.prompt: Which of these South American countries is landlocked?
questions.explain: The UN list of landlocked developing countries includes Bolivia; Chile, Peru and Ecuador have Pacific coasts.

questions.prompt: Which of these Balkan countries has no sea coast?
questions.explain: The UN list of landlocked developing countries includes North Macedonia; Albania, Montenegro and Croatia border the Adriatic Sea.

questions.prompt: Which of these African countries is landlocked?
questions.explain: The UN list of landlocked developing countries includes Malawi; its neighbours Tanzania and Mozambique, and Kenya, all have coasts.

questions.prompt: Which Southeast Asian country has no sea coast?
questions.explain: The UN list of landlocked developing countries includes the Lao People's Democratic Republic; Cambodia, Thailand and Vietnam all have coasts.

questions.prompt: Which of these Asian countries is landlocked?
questions.explain: The UN list of landlocked developing countries includes Uzbekistan; Iran, Turkey and Pakistan all have sea coasts.

questions.prompt: Which of these landlocked countries has the largest area?
questions.explain: Natural Earth outlines give Kazakhstan about 2706000 km2, ahead of Mongolia at about 1561000 km2; all four are on the UN list.

questions.prompt: Which single country completely surrounds Lesotho?
questions.explain: Natural Earth boundary data shows South Africa as Lesotho's only neighbour.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Mongolia?
questions.explain: Ulaanbaatar is the capital of Mongolia.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Zambia?
questions.explain: Lusaka is the capital of Zambia.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Paraguay?
questions.explain: Asunción is the capital of Paraguay.
